title: Zoom FFT
text: High-resolution FFT of a portion of a spectrum, 2 inputs, {Sample rate mode} sets Mode to specify input sample rate Use normalized frequency; {Decimation factor}, {Specify center frequency from input port} sets the flag to specify center frequency from input, {Center frequency}, {Inherit FFT Length from input dimensions} sets the flag to inherit FFT length from input, {FFT length}, {Input sample rate (Hz)}, {Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Specify center frequency from input port
params.values: Flag to specify center frequency from input port ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Inherit FFT Length from input dimensions
params.values: Flag to inherit FFT length from input dimensions ’on’ (default) | ’off’

params.name: Sample rate mode
params.values: Mode to specify input sample rate Use normalized frequency (0 to 1) (default) | Specify on dialog | Inherit from input port

params.name: Input sample rate (Hz)
params.values: Input sample rate 44100 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals
params.values: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
